sentences.text: I have an Apple 30” cinema display and new Mac Book Pro Laptop.
The 30” cinema display has a max resolution (which I use) of: 2560x1600.
The screen is huge and is sure to give me a huge productivity boost for my work.
The price tag on the 30” apple display is around 2k USD, but over time it’ll pay for itself.
Ever since I got an iMac several months ago, I will never go back to PC hardware.
Everything is bright, nice, fast, and overall just plain better with Apple.
